lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 7 distinct white vertical lines are visible; spacing is irregular, with larger gaps between the 2nd/3rd and 5th/6th lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 6th and 7th lines terminate mid-flank before reaching the ventral region; the 2nd line is significantly shorter and lower in contrast compared to the 3rd line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 4-5 high-contrast white spots is located on the lower posterior haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper haunch align vertically, continuing the trajectory of the final torso line.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature; the horns spiral outward from the pedicles before curving inward and upward at the terminals.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The span between the terminal tips is approximately 4.0 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The bright ivory-colored tips constitute approximately 12% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a white dorsal mane extending from the neck to the tail; white facial chevron and cheek spots; high-contrast orange 'socks' on all four limbs.
